verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no first-party data export feature, such as a bulk download, CSV or ICS export, or account data archive. SavvyCal has a JSON REST API with endpoints like GET /v1/events, but that is a developer building block a user could use to build their own export, not an export capability itself, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
